planning_derivation: F1 plus Eq68: balanced n/2 per dataset implies LCB>=G-6*mean(sqrt(rho_h))*sqrt(t/n)-24*t/n with t=log(12J/delta). Invert this strictly to plan even n.
inference_scope: Existing repeatedly inspected development questions, fixed finite pools and overlapping historical fits. This is neither fresh-data certification nor empirical proof of population power.
original_equation69_scope: iid target mixture assumption; shown separately from fixed-balanced F1 sample size

sample_size_quantity_scope.necessary_counts: No information-theoretic necessary count is inferred from the development-data planning table.
sample_size_quantity_scope.equation69: Sufficient count for the specified empirical-Bernstein certificate, given population rho and iid incoming question clusters with arbitrary within-question repeat dependence.
sample_size_quantity_scope.fixed_balanced_F1: A certificate-specific sufficient planning corollary for independent questions within each fixed stratum, derived from Eq68 and F.1.
sample_size_quantity_scope.plugin_inputs: True population rho and variance are unknown. Values substituted here are estimates from repeatedly inspected development questions, not established population upper bounds.
sample_size_quantity_scope.interpretation: Numbers such as125000 describe the sufficient count of this conservative certificate with these plug-in assumptions. They are not a lower bound on the question needs of every possible algorithm.
